questionBank.question: Which thermodynamic variable is conserved during both dry and reversible moist pseudoadiabatic ascents without precipitation in NWP models?
options: Equivalent Potential Temperature (Theta-e)
Virtual Temperature (Tv)
Dew Point Temperature (Td)
Dry Static Energy (s)
questionBank.explanation: Equivalent potential temperature (Theta-e) is conserved during both dry and reversible moist pseudoadiabatic processes.

questionBank.question: What is the primary operational advantage of the Arakawa C-grid staggering utilized in the WRF model?
options: Staggering velocity components (u, v) at cell faces and mass variables (T, P) at cell centers to optimize gravity wave dispersion
Placing all variables at cell vertices to eliminate numerical diffusion
Eliminating horizontal advection terms completely
Using triangular spherical harmonics across poles
questionBank.explanation: Arakawa C-grid provides optimal phase dispersion characteristics for gravity waves at high spatial resolution.

questionBank.question: In 4D-Var Data Assimilation, what is the core role of the Adjoint Model?
options: To integrate sensitivity gradients of the cost function backwards in time to obtain optimal initial state perturbations
To project satellite radiances onto radar radial beams
To smooth terrain topography automatically
To extrapolate 10-day forecasts without dynamic integration
questionBank.explanation: The adjoint operator integrates the cost function gradient backwards in time over the assimilation window.

questionBank.question: In dual-polarization weather radar, what physical characteristic does Differential Reflectivity (ZDR) primarily indicate?
options: Median oblateness and axis ratio of hydrometeors (horizontal vs vertical diameter ratio)
Total atmospheric water vapor volume only
Radial wind shear in knots
Echo top height above mean sea level
questionBank.explanation: ZDR = 10 * log10(Zh / Zv), giving direct geometric insight into raindrop flattening during fall.

questionBank.question: Which Doppler radar radial velocity signature indicates an intense downdraft / microburst striking the surface?
options: Strong low-level radial velocity divergence centered at the heavy precipitation core
Uniform cyclonic rotation at 10 km altitude
Pure inbound velocities across the entire 360-degree azimuthal scan
Zero Doppler spectrum width without velocity gradient
questionBank.explanation: Surface outflow from a microburst diverges horizontally in all directions, creating a distinct divergent radial velocity signature near ground.
